item.text: There isn’t an existing `keybindings.json`, so I’m creating one with a single scoped binding: `Ctrl+J` runs VS Code’s editor-focus command only while the terminal has focus.
`jq` isn’t installed here, so I’m validating the JSON with Node instead.

Done. I created [keybindings.json](/home/user/.config/Code/User/keybindings.json) with:

`Ctrl+J` -> `workbench.action.focusActiveEditorGroup` when `terminalFocus` is active.

The JSON is valid. VS Code should pick it up automatically; if it does not, reload the VS Code window.
